prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 9:16 cinematic noir portrait of a sophisticated 24-year-old adult woman seated upright in the rear of a moving taxi on a rain-soaked city night. She has loose wavy hair, a calm thoughtful gaze, a black long-sleeve satin blouse, tailored dark trousers, a dark blazer, and layered unbranded gold chains. One hand rests near the rain-streaked window and the other holds an unreadable phone face-down. Show realistic black leather stitching, blurred red-and-amber traffic bokeh, and dim blue street ambience. Use red tail-light glow, refracted rain highlights, a 35mm moody film-still look, natural skin texture, subtle digital noise, and no text or logos.
